minutes.headline: School Committee approved Nature's Classroom trip, district handbooks and appreciation resolutions; ESSER reallocation tabled.
minutes.summary: Three members met remotely. They approved the Nature's Classroom trip with an overnight and a day option, accepted the substitute and custodial handbooks, and adopted appreciation resolutions. The business manager presented proposed ESSER reallocations, which were held for the full committee and public comment. The superintendent presented communications survey results and the future of the primary school AC project.

public_comment.topic: Asked for a one-time waiver of the snack shack food policy to sell hot pizza at a large track meet in May.
Asked when the transportation policy on no busing under 1.5 miles, promised for April, would be addressed.

Keep the project in the capital plan for town meeting; hire an electrical engineer first, and seek more funding in the fall if costs exceed the plan.

Proposed moving surplus to keep the primary school guidance counselor another year and moving funds from after-school to the nurse supervisor stipend.

what_happened.line: The ESSER budget amendment was tabled until the full committee is present and public comment can be gathered.
The business manager proposed moving surplus ESSER 2 funds to keep the primary school guidance counselor another year and to fund a nurse supervisor stipend.
The committee approved the Nature's Classroom trip 3-0 by roll call, with an overnight and a day option; bus costs were still unknown.
The committee accepted the substitute and custodial handbooks 3-0 and adopted the appreciation resolutions 3-0.
The superintendent said the primary school AC project stays in the capital plan for town meeting, with an electrical engineer to be hired first.

why_it_matters: The ESSER reallocation, which touches school staffing such as a guidance counselor and a nurse stipend, has not been decided and is meant to get public comment first.
The primary school AC project may need more funding in the fall if costs exceed the capital plan, which could come back to residents as a town meeting vote.
watch_next: The ESSER amendment returning to the full committee; the presentation is to be posted online and sent to the finance committee.
A possible special meeting before May 14 to vote on a special event permit for pizza sales.
